rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF

positions.name: ProShares UltraPro QQQ (3x Nasdaq-100)
positions.catalyst: Tech relief rally after a two-day AI/semi washout (Micron -7%, AMAT -7.4%, AMD -4.3%, NVDA -2.1% over prior two sessions). Mon 7/6 pre-market: Nasdaq-100 futures +1%, SMH semis +2.4%, oil falling, AI-overbought jitters easing. Broad risk-on across mega-cap tech.
positions.driver: 3x long the Nasdaq-100 to ride the dominant bullish theme of the day with leverage matched to a strong fresh catalyst. Chose TQQQ over SOXL specifically because SOXL had already gapped ~+8.6% pre-market (trips the no-chase rule), whereas TQQQ is up only ~+3.4% off the prior close — a far better entry — and its basket diversifies single-name blow-up risk versus a pure-semi 3x fund. Bullish continuation of an oversold bounce with a real narrative (oil down, jitters easing).
positions.risks: Dead-cat-bounce risk: two-day washouts can resume on a third down leg, and 3x amplifies any reversal. AI-overbought narrative (OpenAI/US-govt stake chatter, Meta selling excess compute) could reassert intraday. Hard 10% stop at $68.28 bounds the downside on the leverage.
